summary:
Over the past year, the bulk of the work has been on Summit, a SaaS crypto algo-trading platform with an AI twist. Built out its LLM judge system, introducing a System One judge seat for quorum, sentiment, and wallet-group decisions, and integrated TypeSafe provider capabilities. Also reworked the rebalancing engine, adding calm-liquidity backtesting and an interactive exit simulator for the follows system, while continuously fixing wallet-group and execution logic.

On the firmware side, advanced the J-UNI-HID project, developing v10 through v13 of the ESP32-S3 mouse and keyboard emulation firmware, adding USB touch, BLE profiles, and self-reporting. Also released v1.2 of the input-driver, a Windows kernel-mode input filter driver, adding push-style event delivery and an integration-test suite.

Across secondary projects, conducted a deep research audit on the crypto-model-research prediction model, built the agent-harness agentic worker framework with Mattermost integration, and developed the sunflower browser-in-a-browser infrastructure. Also expanded the j-tts-android TTS app with multiple new engines and pitch control, and maintained the intag2 Windows Explorer tagging utility with metadata and CI improvements.

items.title: LLM judge and quorum system
items.description: Built a System One judge seat for quorum, sentiment, and wallet-group decisions; integrated TypeSafe provider capabilities and improved judge call recording.

items.title: Agentic worker framework
items.description: Developed the Mattermost bridge, feed processing, and schema-driven agent communication for the Jamminroot Agentic Worker.

items.title: Browser-in-browser infrastructure
items.description: Reworked font pack delivery, browser lifecycle management, and human-input simulation for the Sunflower remote browser platform.

items.title: YOLO labeler tooling
items.description: Added constraint highlighting, label transparency, and validation features to the on-host YOLO labeler.

items.title: Rebalancing and follows engine
items.description: Implemented calm-liquidity backtesting, interactive exit simulator for follows, and reworked wallet-group veto logic.

items.title: Crypto model research audit
items.description: Conducted a full research audit: unified protocol sweep, conformal prediction gates, drift monitoring, and benchmark freezing for the crypto price prediction model.

items.title: Agent harness core architecture
items.description: Built the core agent architecture: situations, canvas, memory search, tiered recommendations, and admin operational dashboard.

items.title: Tagging utility and browser platform
items.description: Fixed settings persistence and Explorer refresh for Intag2; added tenant fencing and operator panel deployment for the Sunflower browser-in-browser service.

items.title: Intag2 release pipeline
items.description: Collapsed the release workflow, added Vorbis comment writing for audio files, and fixed uninstall path issues.

items.title: Trading strategy iteration
items.description: Added several new 15m trading strategy variants with documented forward-test performance.

items.title: CV generation pipeline
items.description: Reworked the CV generation pipeline: added dry-run mode, split LLM guidance, refined importance tagging, and improved heatmap rendering.

items.title: Jolt automation utility
items.description: Built the scenario engine for Jolt, a minimal AutoHotKey alternative, with interception support, conditions, and sound actions.

items.title: Strategy backtesting
items.description: Added and documented new EwoDip and reversion strategy variants for the freqtrade backtesting suite.

items.title: HID firmware and input driver
items.description: Developed v13 firmware for the ESP32-S3 HID device and released v1.2 of the Windows input filter driver with push-style event delivery.

items.title: Android TTS engine expansion
items.description: Integrated multiple TTS engines, added pitch control, RuNorm text normalisation, and question/exclamation intonation sliders.

items.title: Aim assist and e-ink firmware
items.description: Refactored YOLO inference to DirectML for MEMU3, and added Knowledge Base app and FB2 reader to the Biscuit e-ink firmware.

items.title: CV project cards and heatmap
items.description: Added project cards with pulse line charts, smoothed Catmull-Rom curves, and weekly heatmap to the CV README.

items.title: Firmware and e-reader apps
items.description: Drafted the v13s8x8 firmware variant and fixed USB disconnect issues; added Map app and FB2 encoding fixes to the Papyrix e-reader firmware.

items.title: Proxy client and tagging tool
items.description: Added XHTTP transport support to the Flutter Clash.Meta client and fixed desktop.ini encoding for non-ASCII characters in Intag2.

items.title: Summit platform foundation
items.description: Continued building the core Summit crypto trading platform, laying groundwork in LLM integration, wallet management, and execution logic.

items.title: HID firmware development
items.description: Developed firmware versions v10 through v12 for the ESP32-S3, adding USB touch, BLE profiles, dual-core support, and self-reporting.

items.title: Mobile and desktop applications
items.description: Built the Ozwil Android LLM app with sub-agent architecture, developed the poker-cv computer vision pipeline, and expanded the intag2 file-tagging utility with PDF support and MS Store publishing.

items.title: Tooling and infrastructure
items.description: Built the auto-claude autonomous coding agent, the jaxon code intelligence engine, the freqtrade multi-bot Telegram interface, and maintained various n8n nodes and dotfiles.

items.title: Bot maintenance
items.description: Maintained the pAssistant Telegram bot and the .NET ChatGPT Telegram bot with general updates and bug fixes.
